mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO textbook_web_pages (cache_scope_key, url_hash, url, site) VALUES (#{cacheScopeKey}, #{urlHash}, #{url}, #{site})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM textbook_web_pages WHERE cache_scope_key = #{cacheScopeKey} AND url_hash = #{urlHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_web_pages SET latest_revision_id = #{revisionId} WHERE page_id = #{pageId} AND latest_revision_id = #{replacing}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO textbook_web_revisions (page_id, content_hash, parser_version, fetched_at, http_status, isbn13, title, authors, publisher, author_notes, published_date, edition, toc_raw, toc_json, toc_entry_count, toc_coverage, toc_version, toc_raw_hash, toc_raw_truncated) VALUES (#{pageId}, #{contentHash}, #{parserVersion}, #{fetchedAt}, #{httpStatus}, #{isbn13}, #{title}, #{authors}, #{publisher}, #{authorNotes}, #{publishedDate}, #{edition}, #{tocRaw}, #{tocJson}, #{tocEntryCount}, #{tocCoverage}, #{tocVersion}, #{tocRawHash}, #{tocRawTruncated})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, p.url, p.site, p.cache_scope_key FROM textbook_web_revisions r JOIN textbook_web_pages p ON p.page_id = r.page_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND
SELECT r.*, p.url, p.site, p.cache_scope_key FROM textbook_web_revisions r JOIN textbook_web_pages p ON p.page_id = r.page_id WHERE AND r.revision_id IN #{id}

SELECT r.*, p.url, p.site, p.cache_scope_key FROM textbook_web_revisions r JOIN textbook_web_pages p ON p.page_id = r.page_id WHERE AND r.page_id = #{pageId} AND r.toc_raw_hash = #{tocRawHash} AND r.toc_version = #{tocVersion} ORDER BY r.revision_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.*, p.url, p.site, p.cache_scope_key FROM textbook_web_revisions r JOIN textbook_web_pages p ON p.page_id = r.page_id WHERE r.parser_version = #{parserVersion} AND r.toc_version < #{tocVersion} AND r.toc_raw IS NOT NULL AND r.toc_raw_hash IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM textbook_web_revisions n WHERE n.page_id = r.page_id AND n.toc_raw_hash = r.toc_raw_hash AND n.toc_version = #{tocVersion}) ORDER BY r.revision_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.*, p.url, p.site, p.cache_scope_key FROM textbook_web_pages p JOIN textbook_web_revisions r ON r.revision_id = p.latest_revision_id WHERE AND r.isbn13 = #{isbn13} AND p.last_fetched_at >= #{since} AND r.parser_version = #{parserVersion} ORDER BY r.toc_entry_count DESC, r.revision_id DESC
